strategyName: ZenBlade Session ORB + VWAP Reclaim v2

currentObservation.backtestResult: No scenario passed the frozen-parameter robustness gate. The leading combined scenario was slightly positive at the current fee but failed fee resilience and had one clearly negative chronological window.

lastDecision: Do not integrate Session ORB + VWAP Reclaim v2 into Railway or the paper loop. The apparent short-sample edge weakened materially on 18000 candles and failed the frozen-parameter robustness gate. Archive the current parameters as a rejected research candidate. Do not tune around the losing middle window or current best hours.
interpretation: The first 6000-candle result overstated the strength of the edge.
The leading setup retained a small positive result at the assumed 0.0008 fee, but its margin is too thin for reliable deployment.
The strategy becomes negative at a 0.0010 fee, showing weak execution resilience.
The middle chronological window was clearly negative, so the edge is regime-dependent and unstable.
ETH contributed positively while BTC reduced the combined result, but removing BTC now would be post-hoc tuning.
Short-only rejection failed on the longer history and should not be treated as a valid edge.
Session-end exits are a visible drag, but changing them after seeing the result would require a new pre-registered hypothesis and independent validation.
knownProblems: No scenario passed the frozen-parameter robustness gate
The leading edge is small relative to fees
The result is negative at a slightly higher effective fee
One of three chronological windows is clearly negative
Alternative subsets are near break-even or negative
Further tuning on the same May-July sample has high overfitting risk
